features.name: Ability Score Racial Traits
features.description: +4 DEX, -2 STR, -2 WIS

features.name: Size
features.description: Small creature; apply global size modifiers once (not twice).

features.name: Type
features.description: Humanoid creature with feline subtype

features.name: Base Speed
features.description: Base land speed 30 feet.

features.name: Languages
features.description: Begin speaking Common and choose either Mithran or Ronsaur; one second starting language is a player choice. High-Intelligence optional languages: Abyssal, Celestial, Elvaan, Galkan, Goblin, Orc.

features.name: Heavy Lifter
features.description: For carrying capacity only, treat Strength as 4 higher.

features.name: Nimble Faller
features.description: Land on feet even from a lethal fall; effective falling distance 10 feet shorter; +1 CMD versus trip.

features.name: Feline Conversationalist
features.description: Understand and communicate with feline animals at will.

features.name: Nimble
features.description: Use Dexterity modifier instead of Strength modifier for Climb and Swim checks.

features.name: Sprinter
features.description: While charging, running or withdrawing, movement speed gains +10-foot racial bonus.

features.name: Bite
features.description: Primary natural bite attack dealing 1d3 damage.

features.name: Claws
features.description: Two primary natural claw attacks dealing 1d3 damage each.

features.name: Cat Senses
features.description: Gain low-light vision and scent.

features.name: Non-threatening
features.description: -4 penalty on Intimidation checks.

features.name: Easily Distracted
features.description: -2 penalty on Concentration checks.

features.name: Naïve
features.description: -2 penalty on Sense Motive checks.

features.name: Big Ears
features.description: +2 Perception on hearing checks; can hear high-frequency sounds inaudible to most people.

features.name: Clever Cat
features.description: +2 racial bonus on Bluff, Diplomacy and Sense Motive checks.

features.name: Climber
features.description: Climb speed 20 feet; inherent +8 racial Climb check benefit.

features.name: Color Thief
features.description: +2 racial Stealth while wearing light or no armor.

features.name: Curiosity
features.description: +4 Diplomacy to gather information; Knowledge (history/local) becomes class skill, or +2 racial if already class skill.

features.name: Dexterous Tail
features.description: Tail carries objects (not weapons); retrieve small carried item as swift action.

features.name: Hunter Companion
features.description: Gain darkvision 60 feet instead of cat senses (including scent and low-light).

features.name: Jungle Stalker
features.description: +2 racial Acrobatics; ignore first foliage-based difficult-terrain square per round.

features.name: Mysterious Red Dot
features.description: Once per day, swift action grants +2 dodge AC for one round.

features.name: Natural Hunter
features.description: +2 racial Perception, Stealth and Survival checks.

features.name: Palico Bravery
features.description: +1 racial attack with non-reach melee when enemy is larger and no allies adjacent.

features.name: Cait Sith heritage ability scores
features.description: +2 DEX, +2 INT, -2 STR, -2 WIS

features.name: Cait Sith heritage ability
features.description: +2 racial Knowledge (nature) and Handle Animal; retain Sense Motive penalty. Source may change Nimble; this is not confirmed.

features.name: Felyne heritage ability scores
features.description: +2 DEX, +2 CHA, -2 STR, -2 WIS

features.name: Felyne heritage ability
features.description: +2 racial Diplomacy; does not suffer Naïve Sense Motive penalty.

favoredRewards.name: Palico Bard favored reward
favoredRewards.description: +1/2 Bluff for lying and +1/2 Diplomacy for information gathering.

favoredRewards.name: Palico Berserker favored reward
favoredRewards.description: +2.5 feet when charging/running through rough terrain; full 5 feet only each 2 selections.

favoredRewards.name: Palico Fencer favored reward
favoredRewards.description: +1/6 to AC bonus from duelist stance.

favoredRewards.name: Palico Gunner favored reward
favoredRewards.description: +1/6 to AC dodge bonus from nimble class feature.

favoredRewards.name: Palico Ninja favored reward
favoredRewards.description: +1/4 attack when attacking on or charging from higher ground.

favoredRewards.name: Palico Thief favored reward
favoredRewards.description: +1/2 Stealth and Perception in dim light or darkness.

favoredRewards.name: Palico Warrior favored reward
favoredRewards.description: +1/2 circumstance bonus to confirm criticals with close/light blade weapons, max +4, nonstacking with Critical Focus.
